title: Enchanting Overhauled
description: Enhances the enchanting experience found in Minecraft!
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2432f94dc62d9b66e6cc6f9f228ba0cdb2b2a6bc.png)

Tired of grinding random levels just to roll an unwanted curse? Enchanting Overhauled is a complete reimagining of Minecraft’s magic system, built to make progression deliberate, rewarding, and deeply tied to exploration.

Discover how Enchanting Overhauled removes the frustration of RNG, replaces obsolete infrastructure with modular altars, and concentrates arcane power so your gear finally feels legendary.

 ![Enchanted Tomes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d723990392a54f96a12aa17837f17e2e2a323e6.png) ## Persistent, High-Potency Tomes Say goodbye to fragile, single-use books. Enchanted Tomes introduce a permanent, highly potent vessel for arcane knowledge. Unlike standard enchanted books, Tomes are fully persistent and remain intact after application. They hold significantly higher tiers and far greater quantities of enchantments, serving as permanent upgrades to your enchanting arsenal. Because this degree of raw power surpasses mortal craftsmanship, Tomes cannot be crafted—they must be recovered through dedicated worldly exploration. ![Enchanting Altars](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c348022074c301e8249f5494cd60294fcc84f310.png) ## The Modular Enchanting Altar The obsolete, RNG-dependent Enchanting Table has been entirely excised and replaced by the multi-stage Enchanting Altar. Existing in three distinct physical states—Deactivated, Disturbed, and Activated—the Altar grants complete, deterministic control over your gear progression. Interacting with an Activated Altar opens the new Enchant Menu, allowing you to upgrade, transfer, and apply specific enchantments directly to your tools and armor. If the current arcane offerings do not suit your immediate build, simply turn the page to instantly cycle the selection. ![Enchantment Themes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba9a0037b0cb63b58d6a9760908e2b537c0e6b07.png) ## Thematic Arcane Gating Advanced magic requires the proper environmental catalyst. Enchantment Themes gate specific, highly specialized incantations behind dimensional or artifact-based power sources. Certain spells have been lost to Overworld sages and remain entirely hidden from standard altars. To unlock them, players must feed the Altar's arcane hunger with rare artifacts scavenged from distinct biomes and alternate dimensions. ![Library Ruins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9ae1624ea19cc935c9d00af887c26a207a9f540.png) ## Lost Overworld Infrastructure Exploration directly feeds your enchanting potential. Archeologists have uncovered Ancient Libraries—pristine architectural ruins scattered throughout the Overworld long thought to be mere myth. Delve into these forgotten halls to uncover historical lore, recover lost thematic artifacts, and secure rare Enchanted Tomes. ![Level Curve](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/833b2b6fd7c81a4582df4a6222415a91239db9b4.png) ## Streamlined Experience Scaling A shift in the astral plane has bestowed a boon of clarity upon the Overworld, sharpening minds and eliminating the late-game experience grind. A re-engineered experience curve accelerates level acquisition, allowing players to reach their full potential rapidly without relying on massive, exploitative mob farms. Accumulate power naturally and pour your soul directly into your equipment. ![Mundane Anvils](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b0a553411b9d3fd1905caf524bc3a73588c394c.png) ## Decoupled Mundane Repairs The physical maintenance of your gear no longer exacts a magical toll. The Anvil’s ties to the arcane have been severed, returning it to purely physical mechanics: repairs and renaming now cost zero experience. To preserve systemic balance, enchanted books can no longer be applied via the anvil, strictly centralizing all magical manipulation to the Enchanting Altar. ![Various Changes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e0829dff26bd37fcd276d04114cea9617eed057.png) ## Comprehensive Arcane Balancing The entire enchantment ecosystem has been aggressively audited for potency, clarity, and tactical depth: - **Strict Capacity Limits:** To prevent thoughtless power-stacking, items can now sustain a strict maximum of **3 enchantments** (curses bypass this matrix restriction). - **Concentrated Potency:** All leveled enchantments now reach their absolute maximum at **Level III**, making each individual upgrade step for Sharpness, Smite, Efficiency, and Extermination (formerly *Bane of Arthropods*) feel vastly more impactful. - **Specialized Wards:** The standard Protection spell has been sundered into two specialized branches: **Physical Protection** and **Magic Protection**. Because heavy defensive wards must be anchored to the body's core, Protection-type enchantments can now only be applied to **Chestplates**. - **Resolved Paradoxes:** Ancient magical conflicts have been brokered into peace. Sages have unlocked the secret to **Infinite Flaming arrows**, Multishot and Piercing can now coexist on the same weapon, and Depth Strider pairs seamlessly with Frost Walker. - **Expanded Utility:** All basic tools now accept damage-scaling enchantments, Frost Walker hardens powdered snow for safe foot traversal, and Aqua Affinity clears underwater murkiness for perfect submerged vision. - **Total Transparency:** Every incantation now exposes its exact functional behavior via comprehensive in-game tooltips. - **Progression Tracking:** Includes a dedicated Advancement for successfully activating your first Enchanting Altar. ![Config Reloaded](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/610f191e77a8ef0631c4df967d3c152c512578d0.png) ## Hot-Reloadable Administration Tailor the entire framework to fit your specific modpack balance. Modify caps, potencies, and systemic rules directly via `config/enchanting_overhauled.properties` or through intuitive frontend interfaces like Mod Menu and NeoForge's Config Editor. Because balancing requires rapid iteration, all configuration changes can be injected instantly into a live environment using the native `/reload` command. ![Developer API](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6abf07c2d91ab4f340f5effb48f5274892a3865.png) ## Data-Driven Extensibility Built from the ground up to support seamless ecosystem integration. Enchanting Overhauled exposes a powerful, entirely data-driven API. Whether you are a modder or a pack developer, you can register custom enchantment themes, assign third-party spells to existing themes, or inject modified tooltip descriptions entirely through standard JSON files—without writing a single line of Java code. ![Acknowledgements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/26ba37747ec6efb96a5e9d340e6f7bf3fb5604b7.png) This project contains or relies on third-party software components. ## Isometric Renders * **Author:** glisco * **Source:** https://modrinth.com/mod/isometric-renders * **Role:** Asset rendering pipeline for documentation imagery. ## Simple-Config * **Author:** magistermaks * **Source:** https://github.com/magistermaks/fabric-simplelibs/tree/master/simple-config * **Role:** Structural foundation for the Fabric configuration file manager. ## MultiLoader-Template * **Author:** jaredlll08 * **Source:** https://github.com/jaredlll08/MultiLoader-Template * **Role:** Foundation for the cross-platform multi-loader build environment (v2.0.1+).
